messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

You're invited to join the DataLab speaker series  10:30-11:30 every Tuesday in DataLab <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/location/> and on Zoom <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/meeting/register/adjlIkQOS0-GASMhXF7g_A>.

Join us for DataLab <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/>’s new speaker series every Tuesday morning this quarter! The series focuses on how researchers use data science methods and technologies in practice. It will include a mix of presentations about active and completed research projects, industry projects, new methods and technologies of interest to the community, and more. The series is organized by DataLab staff and graduate student affiliates.

For our inaugural meeting on April 21st, Dylon Fleming (UC Davis Dept. of Physics and Astronomy) will present “Data Management in the Accelerator Neutrino Neutron Interaction Experiment (ANNIE)”.

Following the presentation, we’ll have a social hour beginning at 11:30. Enjoy tea, coffee, and light snacks while you connect with others from across the UC Davis community.

Please help spread the word. All members of the UC Davis community (students, staff, and faculty) are welcome to attend. We look forward to seeing you there!

Questions? Interested in presenting or becoming an affiliate? Contact  dat...@ucdavis.edu.
